## Coherent Launches PhotonLink AI Datacenter Optics Product

AI datacenter scaling is increasingly interconnect-constrained; COHR entering with a purpose-built AI optics product positions it to compete for design wins in a structurally growing segment — the thesis inflection point is customer adoption rate, which the headline does not address but design-win disclosures in coming quarters will.

- COHR introduced PhotonLink, a new product targeting AI datacenter optical interconnect applications.
- The launch represents a direct product entry into the AI-native high-speed optics market.
- Coverage from SimplyWallSt frames the launch as a potential investor action item.
- No shipment volumes, customer commitments, or pricing were specified in the headline.
- The product targets a market where bandwidth demand is structurally accelerating with AI compute density.
